note: Warm isolated-process measurement. Other apps may affect speed. Fixed LibriSpeech-PC text_raw subset with natural case and punctuation, including quotation marks. Clean English book reading, not spontaneous dictation. Formatted scores measure agreement with one restored written reference, not uniquely correct editorial style. Formatting and lexical scores recomputed from preserved first-pass transcripts using frozen scorers; original inference, timings and parameters are unchanged. Punctuation/casing metrics are conditional; coverage is retained. Three quote-bearing clips are exploratory only. Text CER measures reference-style agreement, not uniquely correct editing.
